newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.050pts to 103.250.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.050pts to 103.250.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.050 points in Wednesday's trading to 103.250 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.825 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.045 points to 100.722, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.365 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.957 points to 1,029.447.
